entries.en: bird; fowl (generic term for birds)
bird of any species; birds in general
bird

entries.zh: 鹙；猛禽（旧指秃鹙一类大型掠食、食腐之鸟）
entries.en: bird of prey; cinereous vulture (鶖, a large carrion-feeding bird)
entries.notes: 仅 R 栏末字残缺；H 鹙、M chŏ 与 L「ave de rapiña」三相吻合，义可定。

entries.zh: 凤（凤凰；传说中太阳之鸟）
entries.en: phoenix — the bird they call “of the sun”; the male, as against the female 凰
entries.notes: L 中 espemacho 疑为 especie macho（雄性）之讹，g 为 que 的缩写。

entries.en: mandarin duck (waterfowl; 鴛, the male of 鴛鴦)

entries.zh: 传说中啄杀双亲的鸟（字头存疑，或为鹈鹕一类）
entries.en: the bird said to kill its parents (a legendary parricidal bird; headword uncertain)
entries.notes: L 可读作 ave que mata a sus padres；H 原作鵜鶘而注[疑:鵃鶘]，M pîr lỗ 与二字均不甚合，词形未能定。

entries.zh: 天鹅（传说自天而降、供中国国王食用之鸟）
entries.en: swan — the bird that comes down from the sky and is eaten by the King of China
entries.notes: L 末字 fotte 义不明。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕一种神鸟（音写 loān/loân、偏旁为“鳥”，疑即“鸾”）
entries.en: [damaged original; gloss uncertain] a mythical bird (first character lost; loān/loân with the 鳥 radical suggests luan 鸞)
entries.notes: L 多处[残]、H 首字缺，仅存音写与鸟旁，释义只能推拟。

entries.zh: 水灾（洪水泛滥、水位上涨）
entries.en: flood; inundation (rising water)
entries.notes: L 起首漫漶；H 第二字原作[疑:尖]，而 M/R 作 chāy 正合「災」，定为水灾。

entries.en: to surpass; to excel; to exceed (sobrepujar, exceder)
to outdo; to surpass (sobrepujar)
to stand out above the rest (出萃, short for 出類拔萃)
extraordinary; uncommon (thing)
to rise above one's kind; to be outstanding
shame; to put to shame, to affront
entries.notes: M 栏作 Bŷ、R 作 chŷ，当为同一条目 ch- 起首之误录。

entries.en: shame; disgrace
to be shamed; to suffer disgrace
to suffer shame

entries.zh: 无意思（难为情、不知所措）
entries.en: to be abashed, at a loss (lit. “no meaning”)
entries.notes: L 后半漫漶，疑为 no sabe lo que ha de hacer（羞而不知所措），与 H「無意思」相应。

entries.zh: 落尽面皮（丢尽脸面，羞得抬不起头）
entries.en: to lose all face; to be too ashamed to raise one's eyes
entries.notes: L 中部漫漶，可辨 aleuantar los ojos（抬眼），与 H 相合。

entries.zh: 素面（不施脂粉、素面示人；此处谓因小事而羞惭）
entries.en: bare-faced, unadorned; to be abashed over trifles
entries.notes: H 原作[疑:白]，而 M chǒu、R zū 皆指「素」，故取素面；与 con poco 的衔接仍有疑。

entries.zh: 薄面（面皮薄、易羞；略有羞惭）
entries.en: thin-faced; somewhat ashamed
entries.notes: H 原作[疑:溥]，M pǒg、R pōg 皆为「薄」，定为薄面。
